submit-testimony.main-main-content-stori: Stories can come from anywhere in the world. No account is needed. You must be 18 or older. Every submission stays private until a human moderator approves it. Please do not include medical records, government IDs, addresses, or other sensitive information.
submit-testimony.main-main-content-write: Write your story, complete human verification, and click Submit testimony. Your story stays private until a moderator approves it.
submit-testimony.main-testimony-form-cho: Choose what readers will see. Use a first name or nickname; do not include private contact details.
submit-testimony.main-testimony-form-you: Your display name must contain 2–80 characters, excluding spaces at the beginning and end.
submit-testimony.main-testimony-form-tex: Text only for now. Please do not include medical records, private contact details, or information about other people without their permission.
submit-testimony.main-testimony-form-i-a: I am 18 years of age or older.
submit-testimony.main-testimony-form-i-h: I have permission to share this account, believe it is truthful, and consent to publication of this text and display name after human review.
submit-testimony.main-testimony-form-i-u: I understand that automated screening may process my story to assist a human moderator. It does not verify that the story is true.
submit-testimony.main-testimony-form-com: Complete the security check, then submit your testimony for review.
submit-testimony.footer-div-human-review: Human-reviewed testimony intake. Author: Please pray for the person who made this website.
